messages.subject: Changing Aspect Ratio of Plot Output
parts:
I have read similar threads on this topic (e.g.: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/Fgpd0LoZ-y8).

Using session$clientData$output_myplot_width and session$clientData$output_myplot_height retrieve the current settings of the height and width.  What I would like to accomplish is to obtain the potential widths and lengths (in terms of pixels) of the plot viewing pane.  Based on the user's input for the aspect ratio I would then be able to write code that would impose a limit on either the height or width.

So for example (if the above isn't clear), if the potential width is 1000 pixels and the potential height is 800 pixels, if the user wants to see a plot on "portrait", the width would be set to 800*8.5/11, whereas if the desired view is landscape, the height would be set to 1100*8.5/11.  Based on my understanding, the clientData values are set after the fact.

Is this possible?
